description: This file defines the class GroupPosBased, which is a part of the FastRoute package. It extends the RegexBasedAbstract class and implements route dispatching logic for grouped positional routes, handling variable routes based on regex pattern matching.

classes.name: GroupPosBased
classes.description: A route dispatcher class that handles grouped positional route matching using regex patterns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with route data, setting up static and variable route mappings.

methods.name: dispatchVariableRoute
methods.description: Performs dispatching for variable routes by matching the URI against regex patterns and extracting route parameters.
